fields.description:
Billing Details on Partner. Always shown here — the Direct/Via-Partner toggle is Operator-only.

=== FIELDS ===

* Billing Entity — Text

* Payment Terms — Picklist: Net 7; Net 30; Net 45

* Billing Contact — Lookup(Contact)

* Invoicing Cadence — Picklist, single value: Monthly

* Billing Email — Email, its own custom field, not from Billing Contact

* Invoicing Currency — standard CurrencyIsoCode, NOT a custom picklist. Marc confirmed the org already reuses the standard field (Slack Aug 13 23:37).

* Payment Method — Picklist: Wire Transfer; ACH

* PO Required — Picklist: Yes; No

* Billing Address — Text, free form

* Remittance Reference — Text

* Tax / VAT ID — Text

* Billing Notes — Long Text Area

=== IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS ===

* This is the canonical set — BUILD-129 mirrors it onto Operator. Confirmed identical on Aug 13, which closes PT-2's open question in Taryn's doc.

* Taryn's doc has Invoicing Currency as a custom USD/CAD picklist — that's wrong, use the standard field.

* No conditional visibility on Partner. Billing Relationship does not exist here.

* Do not mark any field required on the page layout. No validation rules are being built yet — decided 2026-08-17.

=== NOTES ===

* Outstanding. Part of Taryn's 'remaining partner fields' work.

* Build on the Dynamic Lightning record page using Dynamic Forms, not the classic page layout.

* Provenance: PT-2.

=== SOURCE ===

* Taryn doc PT-2

* Aug 13 call — full spec

* Slack Marc Aug 13 23:37

Dependencies: BUILD-136

Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer

Remember to update the requirements documentation as part of this change.

Created 2026-08-17 from the Operator/Partner ticket review, approved by Kobi.

comments.body: Not yet built, per this ticket's own notes — part of the "remaining partner fields" work. Spec calls for the Partner Billing Details set: Billing Entity, Payment Terms (picklist: Net 7/Net 30/Net 45), Billing Contact lookup, Invoicing Cadence (picklist: Monthly), Billing Email (own custom field), Invoicing Currency (standard CurrencyIsoCode), Payment Method (picklist: Wire Transfer/ACH), PO Required (picklist: Yes/No), Billing Address, Remittance Reference, Tax/VAT ID, and Billing Notes, with no conditional visibility on Partner.
